title: Feed consumer crash (with GS.19b crash after outbox delivery)
source: lab/TARGETS.md section 6 row 19, section 6.1 (GS.19b), section 1.1 P3 items 4 to 6
story: The dependency-index consumer crashes mid-stream and resumes from its checkpoint. Added schedule GS.19b: the consumer crashes after delivering an outbox item but before recording completion.
checked: No gap, no duplicate processing, per-subject order kept; catch-up lag measured. Crash points: before the effect, after the effect before the checkpoint (GS.19b), after the checkpoint. GS.19b: the receiver deduplicates by the delivery key, so exactly one externally visible effect.

witnesses.positive: subjects with E-Verify signals in the live phase (delivered to the receiver)
witnesses.negative: idle onboarded subjects (never in a live-phase transaction, so never delivered)

domain: the dependency-index affected-subject set including subjects reached through referenced entities (O-DOMAIN)
faults: after the effect before the checkpoint (GS.19b)

oracle.source: O-REPLAY (directly written subjects per transaction, receipts); O-DOMAIN (referenced-entity dependencies)
gaps: the outbox is the Triplex journal itself; an atomic outbox table in the source transaction (TARGETS section 3) is not in the triplex-public composition
